subject.title: fix(agents): fallback retry image safety and partial execution detection

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's fail-closed cross-provider media behavior and boundary-only partial-execution plumbing, or require an explicit media trust policy plus production partial-execution capture before merge?
rationale: The PR changes a sensitive provider disclosure boundary and retry/session behavior, while the canonical issue still needs maintainer direction on defaults and compatibility.

options.title: Require complete guarded implementation
options.body: Ask for a rebased PR that guards CLI and embedded prompt-image loading, adds production partialExecution capture or removes that claim, and includes real fallback proof.

options.title: Accept privacy-first default
options.body: Maintain fail-closed cross-provider media behavior as the intended default, but still require the CLI gap, proof, and docs/tests before merge.

options.title: Pause in favor of trust-policy design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and close or supersede this PR if maintainers want an explicit configurable media trust policy instead.

recommendation.title: Require complete guarded implementation
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebased PR that guards CLI and embedded prompt-image loading, adds production partialExecution capture or removes that claim, and includes real fallback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame and recent embedded-runner history make this the strongest available routing candidate from the inspected repository evidence.
